findings.summary: Fernwood achieves a higher mean test AUROC (80.6) than Quillgate-GBDT (80.3) across the five benchmarks, but the difference is small (0.3 points) and no significance test was reported.
findings.scope: Mean over five tabular benchmarks, test AUROC ×100
findings.caveats: No statistical tests were run; difference may not be reliable.

findings.summary: Fernwood outperforms Quillgate-GBDT on three benchmarks (Alder-Credit: 82.1 vs 80.4; Birchfield-Churn: 87.3 vs 86.0; Edgerton-Default: 70.2 vs 67.8) but underperforms on two (Cobalt-Insure: 72.1 vs 73.9; Dunmore-Fraud: 91.1 vs 93.5).
findings.scope: Per-benchmark test AUROC ×100 on five tabular benchmarks
findings.caveats: No significance tests; results vary by benchmark.

findings.summary: Fernwood's mean AUROC (80.6) is higher than Mesh-MLP's (78.3), and Fernwood outperforms Mesh-MLP on all five benchmarks individually.
findings.scope: Mean and per-benchmark test AUROC ×100 on five tabular benchmarks
